definitions.gloss: dawn of an era; early period; infancy
definitions.explanation: The very beginning or earliest stage of a field, movement, era, or technology. A formal and literary term often used in historical, academic, and journalistic writing.

examples.japanese: ⟦インターネット→インターネット：04723_intaanetto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{黎明期|れいめいき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}っている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: I remember the early days of the internet.

examples.japanese: {日本映画|にほんえいが}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{黎明期|れいめいき}⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I'm researching the dawn of Japanese cinema.

examples.japanese: AI⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧{黎明期|れいめいき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、すでに⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}え→与える：01821_ataeru⟧⟦{始|はじ}めている→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: AI technology is still in its infancy, but it has already begun to have a major impact on society.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{黎明|れいめい}→黎明：10199_reimei⟧ (dawn, daybreak) + {期|き} (period). Literally the "dawn period" of something.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {黎明期|れいめいき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (be in the early stages)
- {黎明期|れいめいき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧ (early-stage technology)
- {黎明期|れいめいき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧ (enter the dawn of)
- {黎明期|れいめいき}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧ (since the early days)

USAGE:
A formal, somewhat literary word. Common in essays, documentaries, and news features looking back at the origins of something. The standalone ⟦{黎明|れいめい}→黎明：10199_reimei⟧ means dawn (literal or figurative) and can be used without {期|き} in more poetic contexts.
